products.title: Oversized Fit Printed zip-through hoodie
products.description:
Description
Zip-through hoodie in heavyweight cotton sweatshirt fabric with a soft brushed inside and print motifs. Jersey-lined hood, a two-way zip down the front, dropped shoulders and long sleeves. Front pockets and ribbing at the cuffs. Oversized fit for a baggy, extra-loose silhouette.

products.description: You can always count on a classic. The Dunk Low pairs its iconic colour-blocking with premium materials and plush padding for game-changing comfort that lasts.
